full-capability.description: An institution reporting every capability. Models a mature paxhitestbed deployment.

ledger-only.description: An institution that can only report a ledger. Receivables are ABSENT, not zero — the console must render "not yet reporting" and exclude it from consolidated receivables.

genuine-zeros.description: Receivables declared and genuinely zero. Contrast with ledger-only, where the same figure is absent — the console must not render these two alike.

restatement-of-final.description: Sequence 2 for a period already reported as final, with income revised down. Supersedes the prior version, which is retained. Must raise final_restated.

unbalanced-ledger.description: Debits do not equal credits, and there is an unposted backlog. Must be ACCEPTED and raise unbalanced_ledger — never rejected at the door.

business-reduced.description: A pharmacy on posinnova. Ledger and receivables only — no budget, no integrity, no enrolment, because those genuinely do not exist there.

empty-groups.description: A dormant month: no income and no expenditure in any OHADA group. Group maps must serialise as {} not [].
